'''Mygo Skinto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who devoted her life to helping the disaffected children of various war-torn worlds. This stemmed from the disappearance of her parents at an early age. Skinto's physical development stopped shortly after the loss of her parents, and she used this to her advantage, often disguising herself as a young child. She became a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative during the [[Battle of Miztoc City]]<ref name="CRO" /> and continued to offer information to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] upon its formation in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Fists of Ion" />

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] she investigated the industrial nightmare world of [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]] and learned of the illegal donation trade being perpetuated on the populace by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Torel Vorne]] and the [[Reuss Corporation]]. She brought the plight of the [[Reussi]] and especially the so-called [[Rust Rats]] (mostly orphaned children) to the attention of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and was part of a [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] mission to disrupt Vorne's operations led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]].<ref name="Fists of Ion" />

Following the success of the mission she remained on Reuss VIII to manage relief efforts.<ref name="Fists of Ion" />
